name: Stack-based Buffer Overflow
summary: A write past the end of a buffer allocated on the stack, often via an unbounded copy such as strcpy/sprintf/gets.
fix_hint: Use a bounded copy (strncpy/snprintf/memcpy with a checked length) and validate input length against the buffer size.

name: Heap-based Buffer Overflow
summary: A write past the end of a heap allocation returned by malloc/calloc/realloc.
fix_hint: Allocate enough space for all indices written (including a terminator), and bound every index by the allocated size.

name: Buffer Underwrite
summary: A write before the start of a buffer, typically via a negative index.
fix_hint: Reject negative indices; check both lower and upper bounds.

name: Out-of-bounds Read
summary: A read outside the bounds of an array or buffer, leaking adjacent memory or crashing.
fix_hint: Validate the index against the array length before reading.

name: Improper Validation of Array Index
summary: An array is indexed by a value derived from input without checking it is within range.
fix_hint: Bound-check the index (0 <= i < length) before using it to read or write.

name: Uncontrolled Format String
summary: User input is used as the format argument of a printf-family function.
fix_hint: Use a fixed format string: printf("%s", user) rather than printf(user).

name: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
summary: An arithmetic operation wraps around, commonly producing an allocation smaller than intended.
fix_hint: Use calloc(count, size) or check the multiply for overflow before allocating.

name: Integer Underflow
summary: A subtraction wraps below zero, typically on unsigned types, yielding a huge value.
fix_hint: Check operands before subtracting; avoid unsigned subtraction that can wrap.

name: Off-by-one Error
summary: A boundary is miscalculated by one, e.g. a loop using <= writes one element past the buffer.
fix_hint: Use a strict bound (i < n) and size buffers for the terminator.

name: Signed to Unsigned Conversion Error
summary: A negative signed length is converted to a large unsigned value passed to a size parameter.
fix_hint: Validate that the length is non-negative and within bounds before converting to size_t.

name: Divide By Zero
summary: An integer division or modulo uses a zero divisor derived from input.
fix_hint: Check the divisor is non-zero before dividing.

name: Double Free
summary: free() is called more than once on the same pointer, corrupting allocator metadata.
fix_hint: Free exactly once on every path; set the pointer to NULL after freeing.

name: Use After Free
summary: Memory is accessed through a pointer after it has been freed.
fix_hint: Do not access freed memory; restructure so the pointer is valid at every use, or null it after free.

name: Use of Uninitialized Variable
summary: A variable is read before it is assigned a value.

name: NULL Pointer Dereference
summary: A pointer that is NULL (often an unchecked allocation or lookup result) is dereferenced.
fix_hint: Check pointers for NULL before dereferencing, especially return values of allocation and lookup.

name: Return of Stack Variable Address
summary: The address of a stack variable is returned and used after the frame is gone.
fix_hint: Return heap-allocated memory or write into a caller-provided buffer.

name: Uncontrolled Recursion
summary: Recursion without a reachable base case exhausts the stack and crashes.
fix_hint: Ensure the base case is always reached, or convert to iteration with an explicit bound.

name: Out-of-bounds Write
summary: Data is written outside the bounds of a buffer; a parent category of stack/heap overflows.
fix_hint: Bound every write index by the buffer size.
